subject: PO issuance & line item mapping for Veridia onboarding
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@veridia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO process - info needed

Hi Alice,

Welcome — glad Veridia is moving forward with the integration. To complete procurement onboarding I need a couple of confirmations so we can issue a Redwood PO and set the spend controls correctly: 

1) The billing contact (name + email) Veridia will use for invoices.
2) Preferred invoice line descriptions and your vendor SKUs (we typically remap to our internal SKU tokens but need your catalog codes for reconciliation).
3) Any constraints on invoice split (e.g., separate invoices for SaaS vs professional services) and whether Net30 works.

Planned PO: we intend to issue an initial PO reference to cover Q3 onboarding and the first month of run rate, with a total spend cap of $75,000. Our internal finance team will break that into two line items (SaaS subscription + Professional Services). If you need different buckets on your side, let us know now so we can align the PO metadata.

I attached the completed onboarding form you sent earlier with a few fields populated. If you can confirm the billing contact and vendor SKUs by EOD tomorrow we can issue the PO on our end.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: Veridia_Onboarding_Form_DRAFT.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Alice Park <alice.park@veridia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO process - info needed

Thanks Irene — looping in procurement finance details. Alice, I assigned a provisional Redwood PO reference for Veridia to use for the onboarding period: PUR-4483. That PO will be issued as a single document but finance requests two line items in the ledger, allocated as follows: 

- PO PUR-4483 - Line 1 (SKU: RW-SUB): SaaS subscription — cap $60,000
- PO PUR-4483 - Line 2 (SKU: RW-PS): Professional services — cap $15,000

Total cap: $75,000. Please confirm you can accept a PO with those two ledger lines and whether you require us to split them into separate invoices or if a single invoice with line-level detail is acceptable. 

Marissa: attaching the draft PO for signature (internal). Alice: please sign the attached onboarding form and return; also send back your vendor SKU mapping so we can add it to Vendor_SKU_Mapping.xlsx.

Ben Carter
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_PUR-4483.pdf (pdf), Vendor_SKU_Mapping_template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alice Park <alice.park@veridia.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Veridia Finance <finance@veridia.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO process - info needed

Hi Ben / Irene — thanks, and congrats on getting this moving. Quick notes from Veridia Finance: 

1) We confirm Net30 payment terms are fine.
2) We received Redwood PO PUR-4483. Our system also created an internal vendor reference: VPO-33421 — please include that on any subsequent invoices you send to us so our AR can match payments.
3) Regarding SKUs: Veridia cannot accept the RW-* SKU tokens in our accounting system — they need to map to our catalog SKUs so invoice import works. Proposed mapping: 
   - RW-SUB => V-SUB-100
   - RW-PS  => V-PS-01

If you're okay with that mapping we'll accept a single invoice with line-level detail (two lines).

I attached the signed onboarding form and our vendor-side onboarding checklist. One small issue: the professional services line in the draft PO references a flat hourly SKU; our contract requires an estimate-of-hours field on the PO. Can you add a notes field with an estimated 120 hours for the initial engagement? Once updated we'll confirm acceptance and process the PO.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Finance Ops | Veridia Health
alice.park@veridia.com

Attachments: Veridia_Onboarding_Form_Signed.pdf (pdf), Veridia_Vendor_Checklist.docx (docx)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@veridia.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO process - info needed

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and the VPO reference. We will: 

- Update our internal PO export to include your vendor reference VPO-33421.
- Replace RW-* tokens in the outgoing invoice metadata with your catalog SKUs (V-SUB-100 / V-PS-01) so your AR import is smooth.
- Add the estimated-hours note (120 hours) to Line 2 of PO PUR-4483.

I've attached the revised PO and an updated Vendor_SKU_Mapping.xlsx that includes your SKU mapping and the notes field. Please confirm that with these changes Veridia accepts PUR-4483 as final. Once you OK we will upload the PO to DocuSign for signature and open the HubSpot deal stage to "Procurement complete".

Irene Choi
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_PUR-4483_REVISED.pdf (pdf), Vendor_SKU_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx)
